short_description: Find ethical backlink gaps against competitors.
description: Compare target and competitor backlink profiles using DataForSEO via SandBase to prioritize relevant referring-domain opportunities, assess anchor health, and identify linkable asset patterns.

install.prompt: Use $backlink-gap-analysis to identify ethical backlink gaps for my domain.
install.cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill backlink-gap-analysis --agent codex
install.global_cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill backlink-gap-analysis --agent codex --global

examples: Compare our-domain.com with two competitors and find ethical backlink gaps.
Audit the anchor text profile for my domain and flag any risks.
What types of content earn links in the developer tools space?
Build a list of publications that cover our industry and link to competitors.
We just launched. What's our realistic path to closing the backlink gap?

optional_inputs: analysis goal (gap analysis, anchor audit, prospect list, asset discovery)

notes: Read-only research. Does not send outreach or create links.
Excludes low-quality, manipulative, or paid-link prospects by default.
Backlink data is directional evidence — databases may lag reality by days to weeks.

schema_resolution.dynamic_lookup: Resolve the capability by capability_id and render its current inputSchema.

endpoints.summary: Summarize a domain or page backlink profile.
List referring domains and their backlink evidence.
Find domains competing for similar backlinks.
Assess anchor-text patterns and topical relevance.
Identify pages that attract links and potential asset patterns.
